name: Word of Recall

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: you and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you

summary: You and up to five willing creatures near you teleport to a sanctuary you prepared.
text: You must first designate the sanctuary by casting the spell in a place dedicated to your deity; casting it with no sanctuary set does nothing.
